neighbours.label: a possessive slot that sets up a location or position ('due to its ___ near the equator')
fire: The island stays warm all year because of its location near the equator.
Depending on its position relative to the front, the storm may strengthen.
The castle was easy to defend thanks to its placement on a high cliff.
Doctors judge a mole by its size, its colour and its position on the body.
The village is famous for its setting at the mouth of a deep valley.
The planet's climate depends on its distance from the star it orbits.
The shop does well because of its spot right next to the train station.
The bird's nest is protected by its height above the forest floor.
quiet: The island stays warm all year because the ocean currents bring hot water.
Depending on how fast the wind blows, the storm may strengthen.
The castle was easy to defend thanks to thick walls and a deep moat.
Doctors judge a mole by whether it itches or bleeds over time.
The village is famous for cheese that farmers have made for centuries.
The planet's climate depends on how much carbon dioxide is in the air.
The shop does well because the owner is friendly and prices are low.
The bird's nest is protected by sharp thorns woven into the sticks.
